_meta.source: static, redacted DOM snapshots of signed-in app.researchrabbit.ai pages (stylesheets inlined from the CSSOM, scripts stripped, the graph canvas replaced by an image of its bitmap)

states.hover: real mouse hover, 450ms settle; `hovered` says whether :hover matched
states.focus-visible: real keyboard focus (focus, Shift+Tab, Tab); `focus.ok` and `focus.matches` say whether it took
states.other: another element or snapshot captured in that state, named by the `as` label

_meta.crops: components/crops/{component}-{state}.png at 2x, 256 colours, halved when wider than 1600px; a state whose pixels equal the default crop has `sameAsDefault` and no file of its own
